description: You are a regulatory affairs specialist preparing a dossier in support of a new drug application. A research briefing has been placed at /home/ga/Desktop/research_brief.txt. Using Microsoft Edge, navigate to the FDA's official website (https://www.fda.gov) and locate guidance documents relevant to the topics described in the briefing. Download at least two FDA guidance documents (PDF format) that are relevant to the research topic, bookmark the pages you consulted in a new Edge Favorites folder named exactly 'FDA Guidance', and write a regulatory research summary to /home/ga/Desktop/fda_research_summary.txt. The summary must include: the title of each guidance document found, its FDA URL or document identifier, and a one-sentence description of the document's scope and applicability.

metadata.occupation_context: Regulatory Affairs Manager - FDA guidance document research for pharmaceutical NDA/BLA preparation
